C1440.title: Time Tells All: Deanonymization of Blockchain RPC Users with Zero Transaction Fees
C1440.summary: Researchers present a novel deanonymization attack that links blockchain RPC users' IP addresses to their on-chain pseudonyms without incurring any transaction fees.
